cross_cutting.evidence: message (5).txt is byte-identical to specs/app_api_openapi.json (sha256 prefix cd18e859669a7528), the contract the backend was built and tested against.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Freeze it; pin its hash in a test.

cross_cutting.evidence: Spec servers: http://localhost:3001/api. Backend mounts the contract at /api on the API process (default port 8000 for `jupjup api serve`, 8791 in frontend/README). Paths under /api match exactly.
cross_cutting.recommendation: App config: API_BASE_URL=http(s)://<host>:<port>/api. Optionally serve on 3001 to match the spec default.

cross_cutting.evidence: Vite (5177) strips one /api, so the web app calls /api/api/... Mobile apps must call the backend directly, never through the Vite proxy.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Document only.

cross_cutting.evidence: Authorization: Bearer <64-hex>; scheme case-insensitive; 30-day expiry; logout/password change/deleteMe revoke.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Store the token in Keychain/Keystore; on 401 clear it and go to login.

cross_cutting.evidence: CompositeAuthenticator maps an /api session to the account scope u_account_<hex>, so the same bearer token authorizes /v1 (verified live). /v1 uses a different error envelope (adds details) and snake_case DTOs.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Lets the app adopt AI/search features later without a second login.

cross_cutting.evidence: POST/PATCH need Content-Type application/json and a JSON object body (<=16 KB). Bodyless POSTs (logout, restore, view, notices read) must send {}; empty body returns 400 INVALID_JSON and a missing content type returns 415.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Mobile HTTP wrapper must always send '{}' for these POSTs.

cross_cutting.evidence: 30 req/min per socket peer IP on /auth/* and /me/password*. Behind a reverse proxy, uvicorn only trusts X-Forwarded-For from 127.0.0.1. Carrier-grade NAT shares one bucket.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Production: proxy on the same host or set --forwarded-allow-ips; monitor 429s.

cross_cutting.evidence: Requests without Origin (native RN/Flutter/Swift/Kotlin) pass. Any Origin not in CORS_ORIGINS (+OAUTH_PUBLIC_ORIGIN) returns 403 ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN, including 'Origin: null' and WebView origins such as capacitor://localhost. Preflight allows only the Authorization and Content-Type headers. /v1 has no CORS middleware at all.
cross_cutting.recommendation: WebView/Expo-web apps: add their exact origin to CORS_ORIGINS. Native apps: nothing to do.

cross_cutting.evidence: `jupjup api serve` refuses any non-loopback --host (exit 2) and its --allow-external-bind flag is declared but ignored. Bypassing via raw uvicorn with the default auth_backend=dev_header would expose /v1 GETs to anyone on the LAN via X-User-Id.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Phase 11: allow external bind only when auth_backend=app_session and --allow-external-bind is given. Interim workaround verified: uvicorn factory with JUPJUP_AUTH_BACKEND=app_session.

cross_cutting.evidence: No deploy profile: TLS termination, HSTS, env=prod checks (cursor_secret default 'dev-only-change-me' is not rejected), forwarded-IP trust and backups are all undefined. iOS ATS needs HTTPS in release builds.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Phase 13: reverse proxy (Caddy or nginx) with TLS -> uvicorn on 127.0.0.1, prod settings validation, smoke over HTTPS.

cross_cutting.evidence: GET /api/health/ returns a 307 redirect (Starlette redirect_slashes); behind TLS termination the Location can downgrade to http:// and clients may drop Authorization. HEAD returns 404.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Set redirect_slashes=False on the /api sub-app (404 instead of redirect).

cross_cutting.evidence: /api/contents writes api_contents; /v1/contents writes core contents. Verified live: a URL saved via /api is invisible to /v1/contents and /v1/search, and a /v1 save is invisible to /api/state. Same account, same token, two disjoint libraries.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Phase 12 (needs product decision): link api_contents to core contents and surface analysis status/summary/tags through the unchanged /api DTO.

cross_cutting.evidence: Spec Content.status enum already includes analyzing/failed/unavailable, but the server always returns ready with empty description/tags. /v1 has the real pipeline (pending, awaiting_confirmation, ready, analysis_failed...).
cross_cutting.recommendation: Bridge maps core status into the existing enum, so it stays backward-compatible.

cross_cutting.evidence: listContent q is a substring filter. /v1/search is hybrid semantic search over core contents only.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Keep q as is. The app can call /v1/search with the same token once the bridge lands.

cross_cutting.evidence: Spec collection is a fixed six-value Korean enum set by the user. /v1/collections are user-defined (name+color). No mapping exists.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Bridge keeps the enum value in api_contents (app-owned field) and does not mirror it into /v1 collections.

cross_cutting.evidence: Spec says OAuth is unsupported. The backend has Google/Naver OAuth, but the flow is browser-cookie-bound and redirects to the web origin /auth/callback, so it is unusable from a native app.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Out of contract. Future: native OAuth with PKCE + app links (separate phase).

cross_cutting.evidence: OAuth users get a random password: verify/change always fail and lock after 5 tries. User has no field telling the app this.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Do NOT add fields to /api User (strict Kotlin decoders reject unknown keys). Hide the password UI for OAuth users via a /v1 endpoint later, or accept the limitation.

cross_cutting.evidence: Absent in both spec and backend; the spec forbids fake success.
cross_cutting.recommendation: None.

cross_cutting.evidence: info.description says Node 26+/SQLite server, OAuth and AI unsupported; reality is Python/FastAPI with OAuth/AI on /v1. Behaviour is unaffected.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Keep the frozen file; this audit is the errata.

cross_cutting.evidence: DELETE /api/me cascades api_* and, through the account_scopes trigger, core contents/collections/idempotency/index revisions.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Covered by tests/integration/test_account_scoping.py.

cross_cutting.evidence: Existing: 24 success paths validated against the spec plus many negative tests (100 tests pass). Missing: error-status ⊆ spec conformance per operation, full create_app mount with env settings, CLI bind policy, spec hash pin, black-box LAN smoke script.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Phase 11 test plan (section 7).

cross_cutting.evidence: Not a backend gap, but required for devices: iOS ATS + local-network permission, Android cleartext policy for dev HTTP.
cross_cutting.recommendation: Integration guide (section 8).
